title: TCG:PRO-019

power.text:
I don't block.
When I move into zone 5, put 2 counters on me.

Devour — Free Action: Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck to put a counter on me.

Life Drain — Exhaust Action: If I'm in zone 4 or 5, score points equal to the number of counters on me.
